name: Zaiden Jernigan
strengths: Jernigan hits the designed hole on one cut and is already into the second level without dancing.
Jernigan finds cutback daylight when the interior clogs and finishes with a clear second gear.
Jernigan runs with enough thump at 5-10 / 195 to move piles and fall forward through contact.
weaknesses: Jernigan still needs to prove every-down pass-protection consistency versus SEC edge free runners.
comparison: Jernigan comps to Breece Hall — 5-10 / 5-11 mold with one-cut vision, cutback feel, and enough juice to finish outside.
projection: Jernigan projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at RB (packages Year 1). Ceiling: All-SEC feature back — the one-cut runner who can thump inside and still stress the edge every down.
schemeFit: Jernigan fits a one-cut zone/gap RB room that values vision, cutback feel, and enough mass to finish.
insiderNotes: Jernigan is a high-board 5-10 / 195 Louisville (Miss.) back who hits on one cut, finds cutbacks, and finishes with thump plus a second gear. Wins with vision and power-speed — a feature-back mold Florida has to stay locked on.
